note: C-9 A/B cliffside. Both style sets ship (A plates+layers AND B plates+layers), so the parallax art is doubled against the A-only cliffside route and the pck needs the squeeze applied where it costs nothing to look at. Lossy goes on the big opaque/semi-opaque painted art; every character cell stays lossless because its alpha edge is the whole read at 0.42x phone scale. Below 2048 px the saving is measured per file, not assumed: a sparse flipbook can cost MORE as lossy WebP than as PNG.
